result.summary: Found several layout and content clipping issues: restaurant names truncated in the horizontal carousel, incomplete category chips, and awkward badge placement on popular cards.

issues.description: Restaurant names under 'Fastest near you' are truncated: 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word, and the third card title is incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure cards and text containers fully display restaurant names without ellipsis/cutoff at card bounds.

issues.description: Category filter row shows a partial empty/white chip on the far right, suggesting incomplete rendering beyond the intentional partial last category.
issues.suggestion: Ensure only real category chips render and spacing/padding doesn’t leave a stray partial pill; hide overflow cleanly if chips scroll.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen card, the '€0 delivery' badge sits over the food image and may obscure important visual content; heart icon also overlays the image without strong contrast.
issues.suggestion: Reposition badges to corners with consistent padding and ensure overlay icons/badges have sufficient contrast or scrim so they remain readable and don’t hide key imagery.

issues.description: Promo banner and section spacing are generally fine, but the green promo CTA and text hierarchy compete slightly with dense white space above the category chips.
issues.suggestion: Tighten vertical rhythm between search, categories, and promo for a cleaner scan path; keep primary CTA contrast as-is.
